contentPattern: Columns block, one row of two cells in either order. Text cell: article paragraphs. Image cell: one image, an optional heading (the asset title; falls back to the image alt) and optional download links (High-Res / Low-Res). At 768px and up the image takes two thirds and the text one third; the image cell shows a title / Download / favourite / share bar on hover or focus.

usage.description: Press releases: a paragraph of article copy beside a downloadable press photo, with the photo left or right.

reuseGuidance: Use for text paired with a downloadable press image. For images without text use media-image; for plain two-column copy use columns-text.
